title: Revenue Management Guideline: Rent in Force on a Due Date for Storage Unit Drafts under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
**Guideline.** For a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the rent the unit notice amount carries for the noticed due date and for the in-flight draft's due date is the rent in force on that due date, which is:

1. the new rent of the most recently noticed retention concession on the agreement, where its effective date is on or before that due date and no rescission is recorded on the agreement;
2. where that does not hold, the new rent of the most recently noticed existing-customer rate increase, where its effective date is on or before that due date and no rescission is recorded;
3. otherwise, the contracted monthly rent.

**Records read.** The rate changes recorded on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: their change reason (retention concession, existing-customer rate increase, increase rescinded), notice date, effective date and new rent. "Most recently noticed" means the rate change of that reason with the latest notice date; it is that change whose effective date is tested. "No rescission recorded" means no rate change with the reason increase rescinded appears on the agreement.

### Selection table

| Latest-noticed retention concession effective on or before the due date | Latest-noticed existing-customer increase effective on or before the due date | Rescission recorded on the agreement | Rent in force |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | No | The concession's new rent |
| No, or none on record | Yes | No | The increase's new rent |
| No, or none on record | No, or none on record | No | Contracted monthly rent |
| either | either | Yes | Contracted monthly rent |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and rents)

- Contracted rent $140.00; an increase to $155.00 noticed in February, effective 1 May. For a due date of 1 May the increase is effective on that day: rent in force $155.00. For a due date of 30 April it is not yet effective: $140.00.
- The same agreement then receives a retention concession to $148.00, noticed later, effective 1 May. For a due date of 1 May: $148.00.
- A concession noticed in March effective 1 April, and a second concession noticed in April effective 1 June. The second is the most recently noticed; for a due date of 1 May it is not yet effective, so the concession tier does not hold and the increase tier is tested next.
- Any rescission on the agreement: neither the concession nor the increase is used; the rent in force is the contracted monthly rent.

The rule is applied separately to each of the two due dates, so the noticed due date and the in-flight draft's due date may carry different rents in force.
